verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:8080 that works with any OpenAI SDK or client, launched via a single binary or a docker run command. Models can be loaded with `local-ai run` from Hugging Face or Ollama sources and are then served through that API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint serves arbitrary loaded models as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
